title: Wire Allocator Into Trading-Engine Main Loop

implementation_summary.martingale_runtime_struct: Added allocator_state: Option<AllocatorState> and strategy_to_sleeve_id: HashMap<String,String> fields to MartingaleRuntime.
implementation_summary.main_rs_helper: runtime_with_allocator_state() parses optional allocator_config + strategy_to_sleeve_id + allocator_state from portfolio JSON, installs state on runtime, returns snapshot.
implementation_summary.main_rs_gate: In the per-strategy loop, before start_cycle_with_futures_preflight: if allocator_allows_new_cycle returns false, record 'martingale_allocator_blocked_new_cycle' event and skip the new cycle. Existing cycles are never touched.

test_counts.trading_engine: 198 passed across all binaries (incl. 3 new R10 P1 integration tests), 0 failed

parity_invariants_maintained: Forward-only: rebalance decision at ts only affects intervals AFTER ts (verified by r10_allocator_rebalance_uses_completed_equity_only_in_main_loop)
Weight-bound: allocator_allows_new_cycle respects eligible sleeve set (carried from AllocatorState in allocator_replay.rs)
No-force-close: existing cycles remain after sleeve switch (verified by r10_allocator_switch_does_not_cancel_existing_cycle)
Opt-in per sleeve: strategies without a sleeve mapping are NOT gated (allocator only applies to configured sleeves)
verdict: R9 allocator is now fully live-ready: the trading-engine main loop consults the allocator before opening any new martingale cycle, the allocator blocks inactive sleeves, and existing cycles are never force-closed. The R9 gap 'main.rs per-tick dispatch wiring is not wired' is CLOSED.
